title: The Information Request

subject.declared_business: Property maintenance services for commercial and residential clients, stated annual turnover under 300,000 GBP
subject.director: Composite individual, UK resident, sole person with significant control on record
subject.review_trigger: A verified law-enforcement information request concerning the director was received. It disclosed no allegation or finding and prompted this relationship review.
subject.practice_instruction: Identify the funds you suspect may be criminal property and explain the observed facts supporting that suspicion. Do not state that the property is criminal property, that a predicate offence occurred, or that any person is guilty.

onward_movement.pattern: The three incoming payments were combined and transferred as one payment to a UK solicitor's client account, referenced with a property matter number, within days of the final incoming credit
onward_movement.destination_note: The destination was identified from the payment details as a UK solicitor's client account associated with the property matter reference

supporting_facts: None of the three senders share a name, address or any known connection with the company, its director or its declared commercial clients, based on account name matching alone
The payment references given, deposit, loan and project share, are inconsistent with each other and do not support one coherent stated purpose
The only supporting document the director provided was a single generic letter that did not name or reconcile the individual senders, amounts, dates or the stated purpose of the payments
When asked to explain the payments, the director described a joint property opportunity involving the three senders, an activity not part of the company's declared property-maintenance business

The information provided does not explain the economic relationship between any of the three senders and the claimed property opportunity, or why each sender's contribution differs so widely in amount

red_flags.label: Multiple unrelated personal senders inconsistent with the customer's established commercial activity
Inconsistent payment references that do not support one coherent stated purpose
Generic supporting document that does not reconcile the senders, amounts, dates or stated purpose
Personal-account receipts pooled into a property-related payment outside the account's established activity
Customer's explanation introduces an undeclared joint-property activity inconsistent with the known business profile
Information supplied does not explain the economic relationship between each sender and the claimed property opportunity

distractor_facts: The law-enforcement information request is known law-enforcement interest and the catalyst for this relationship review. It is not, on its own, a basis for suspicion and must not be counted as a red flag

The receiving solicitor's client-account status is a standard, lawful arrangement for property-related payments. It is neither suspicious nor exculpatory on its own and must not be counted as a red flag
